query: For my 42-year-old male patient: among males 37–47 admitted with primary AKI, what's the 75th percentile hospital LOS (days)?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.75) within GROUP (ORDER BY icustays.los) AS percentile_75 FROM admissions JOIN patients ON admissions.subject_id = patients.subject_id JOIN icustays ON admissions.stay_id = icustays.stay_id WHERE patients.gender = 'M' AND patients.anchor_age = 42 AND admissions.admission_type = 'primary AKI' AND (37 <= patients.anchor_year AND patients.anchor_year <= 47);
